content:
sophia: kicking off canary for rlw-service (helm chart redwood/rlw) v2.14.0 -> canary 10% in eu-west1. heads-up: new values set worker_count=8 in prod-values.
sam: noted. deploy-bot shows postUpgrade hook started.
dev-deploy-bot: deploy started: rlw-service v2.14.0 canary=10% (eu-west1) — revision=20250321-14-2. logs: postUpgrade hook 1/3 failing.
ja: quick look at pod logs — OOMKilled on worker process, memory jumped ~3x vs baseline. suspect worker_count or workers spawning extra threads.
liam: I think the values bump is too aggressive for this instance type. previous safe chart was 2.13.7 with worker_count=2. Recommendation: pin fallback to 2.13.7 and apply a hotfix values override to keep worker_count=2 while we investigate.
sophia: options: 1) rollback to 2.13.7 (fast but loses some features), 2) patch values to revert only worker_count & resource requests and continue rollforward. Prefer minimal blast-radius -> hotfix values.
ops-oncall: change window is 02:00-04:00 UTC. This is outside window. If we do a values-only hotfix and keep canary traffic limited, I approve emergency fix. :white_check_mark:
liam: hotfix plan:
```
# dry-run first
helm upgrade rlw-service redwood/rlw --namespace prod --version 2.14.0 \
  --set worker_count=2,resources.requests.memory=512Mi,resources.requests.cpu=300m \
  --timeout 5m --wait --dry-run
```
then apply without --dry-run and promote canary to 50% after 10m of stable metrics.
sophia: I'm going to run the dry-run now.
sophia: dry-run succeeded, no template errors.
sophia: applying hotfix now.
dev-deploy-bot: upgrade started: rlw-service v2.14.0 canary=10% with override (worker_count=2)
dev-deploy-bot: postUpgrade hook succeeded.
jia: metrics look back to normal for the canary pods (memory CPU down to expected percentiles). no restarts in last 6m.
liam: pin fallback command (run after we confirm):
```
helm upgrade rlw-service redwood/rlw --namespace prod --version 2.13.7 --reuse-values --set image.tag=2.13.7
```
we won't run this unless we need to forcibly rollback.
sophia: promoting to 50% now; will watch SLOs and logs for 30m before 100%.
dev-deploy-bot: canary traffic increased to 50% (eu-west1). monitoring hooks enabled.
ops-oncall: thanks for the quick coordinated response. document the values change in the release notes and add a blameless note in the postmortem if behavior regresses.
jia: adding a small alert to detect worker_count drift vs expected values in CI for future releases.
ops-oncall: ack :thumbsup:
